title: Robinhood Ventures Fund II invests in Opalite Health
summary: Robinhood Ventures Fund II backed Opalite Health in August 2026, supporting faster expansion of AI medical interpretation across health systems.
body_markdown:
###


Robinhood Ventures Fund II is a publicly traded investment vehicle managed by Robinhood Ventures. Its portfolio has included an investment in Opalite Health. Investors should review the fund’s current holdings, prospectus, fees, and risk disclosures directly.


###


The investment does not itself change a healthcare customer’s contract, implementation, or service commitments. Those remain governed by the customer’s agreement with Opalite.


###


General-purpose translation tools and healthcare-specific medical interpretation platforms serve different workflows. Opalite provides real-time interpretation across more than 150 languages and dialects, Guardian quality monitoring, and clinical workflow support. Before using any tool with protected health information, verify privacy terms, clinical evidence, and documentation capabilities.


###


Owning shares in a fund that holds Opalite is not the same as owning Opalite directly. Investors should verify the fund’s current holdings and review its prospectus, fees, liquidity, and risk disclosures before making an investment decision.


###


Opalite uses healthcare-specific AI with real-time quality monitoring through Opalite Guardian. In a published validation study conducted with Johns Hopkins Medicine, Opalite reported fewer major and critical errors under the published study conditions compared with certified medical interpreters in Spanish, Mandarin, and Cantonese under the study conditions.
